description: Source code for PyTorch's Dynamo autograd compilation, including functions for managing autograd graphs, caching, and interaction with Python via pybind11. Implements a custom autograd engine that converts autograd graphs to FX graphs for compilation and caching.

classes.name: RuntimeState
classes.description: Holds callables created during forward pass, used at runtime for autograd hooks.

classes.name: RuntimeStateGuard
classes.description: RAII guard for RuntimeState, manages active_rstate pointer.

classes.name: CacheNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the shadow cache graph, manages cache hits/misses, dynamic sizes, and associated compiled functions.

classes.name: InputBuffers
classes.description: A map from Node* to InputBuffer, used during autograd graph processing.

classes.name: LockGuardWithErrorLogs
classes.description: RAII lock guard that prevents nested compiled autograd calls, with error handling.

classes.name: PythonLogger
classes.description: Handles logging messages to a Python logger object.

classes.name: VerboseLogger
classes.description: Extends PythonLogger with additional logging for cache misses and shape changes.

methods.name: bind_function
methods.description: Binds a C++ function to Python, creating a Python callable that wraps the function.

methods.name: call_function
methods.description: Calls a method on the Python autograd compiler object with given inputs and output metadata.

methods.name: wrap_int_list
methods.description: Converts a vector of int64_t to a Python list.

methods.name: convert_pyobj_list
methods.description: Converts a vector of SafePyObject to a Python tuple.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if a PyObject* is not null, throws Python error if null.

methods.name: validate_outputs
methods.description: Validates autograd outputs against expected metadata.

methods.name: set_autograd_compiler
methods.description: Sets or disables the autograd compiler in Python, enabling or disabling compiled autograd.

methods.name: compiled_autograd
methods.description: Main function to run compiled autograd, managing cache, graph traversal, and execution.

methods.name: _compiled_autograd_impl
methods.description: Internal implementation of autograd compilation, graph traversal, caching, and FX graph extraction.

methods.name: torch_c_dynamo_compiled_autograd_init
methods.description: Initializes the Python module for autograd compilation hooks.
